description: We are students from instituto cervino.
summary: We developed a musical composition by transforming sounds from space into music. We used real space sounds, such as signals and waves captured by scientific instruments, and converted them into musical elements to create a unique song. Our project addresses the challenge by showing how science and music can work together to make space sounds easier and more interesting to experience. It is important because it helps people discover that space is not completely silent and encourages curiosity about the universe. Through this project, we combined creativity, technology, and science to turn information from space into something people can listen to and enjoy.
details: We transformed the sounds of space in music, our impact is to show other people how the space that we live in sounds and that space is not quiet at all. To do our project, we used bandlab an app that is perfect to chromebooks. Our project is creative, because only the fact that we are making music is creative, because to make music, yo have to be really creative. And we considered using sounds that are really from space, we used the nasa apps, like the one that we use, that is Sinister Sounds From The Tolar System etc.
